BackstoryDef.title: Institute-Raised
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] was raised entirely within the Institute, educated by its best instructors and shielded from the surface [PAWN_pronoun] was told wasn't worth seeing. [PAWN_pronoun] absorbed its priorities before [PAWN_pronoun] was old enough to question them.

BackstoryDef.title: Director of the Institute
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] holds the Institute's highest office, weighing every division head's proposal against a single standard: does it move the organization's work forward. [PAWN_pronoun] frames every decision, including the difficult ones, as necessary progress rather than choice.

BackstoryDef.title: Prodigy Engineer
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] showed an aptitude for reactor design and applied physics well ahead of [PAWN_possessive] peers, and the Institute's instructors made sure that aptitude was put to use immediately.

BackstoryDef.title: Head of Advanced Systems
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] runs Advanced Systems, overseeing the Institute's reactor and synth-chassis research with an exactness that leaves little tolerance for error. [PAWN_pronoun] left a promising career on the surface for the certainty of unlimited resources and no oversight but [PAWN_possessive] own.

BackstoryDef.title: Security Track Recruit
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] was selected early for the Institute's internal security track, trained to treat containment breaches and surface leaks as the same category of problem: solvable, given the right procedure.

BackstoryDef.title: Head of the Synth Retention Bureau
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] runs the Synth Retention Bureau and functions as the Institute's closest thing to a military commander, authorizing courser deployments to retrieve or eliminate synths that stop following orders. [PAWN_pronoun] treats every escaped unit as an open file, not a person.

BackstoryDef.title: SRB Cadet
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] trained under the Synth Retention Bureau's field program, learning to run surface retrieval operations with minimal exposure and minimal questions asked afterward.

BackstoryDef.title: SRB Field Officer
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] handles the Synth Retention Bureau's surface recovery operations, coordinating courser teams and reporting directly to Ayo. [PAWN_pronoun] spends more time above ground than almost anyone else in the Institute and trusts the surface for it even less than [PAWN_possessive] superiors do.

BackstoryDef.title: Bioscience Track Student
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] specialized early in the Institute's biological sciences curriculum, drawn to questions of adaptation and survival that the surface answered the hard way and the Institute preferred to answer in a controlled setting.

BackstoryDef.title: Head of BioScience
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] leads BioScience, overseeing research into radiation resistance, FEV, and biological weapons applications with the same procedural detachment [PAWN_pronoun] brings to everything else. Colleagues describe [PAWN_objective] as thorough. None describe [PAWN_objective] as warm.

BackstoryDef.title: Robotics Track Apprentice
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] apprenticed in the Institute's robotics division, working through chassis designs and synthetic musculature schematics years before [PAWN_pronoun] was permitted anywhere near a live unit.

BackstoryDef.title: Head of Robotics
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] leads the Robotics division and is credited within the Institute as the principal architect of the third-generation synth line. [PAWN_pronoun] speaks about the units [PAWN_pronoun] designed the way an engineer speaks about a bridge, proud of the specifications and uninterested in whether the bridge has opinions.

BackstoryDef.title: Head of Facilities
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] keeps the reactor fed, the air clean and the lights on for everyone else's research, and [PAWN_pronoun] makes sure the Directorate never forgets it. [PAWN_possessive] patience for the surface was never high. Division heads who treat Facilities as a janitorial service get even less of it.

BackstoryDef.title: Facilities Administrator
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: Food and housing in the Institute both pass across [PAWN_nameDef]'s desk. When two divisions are at each other's throats, people go to [PAWN_objective], mostly because [PAWN_pronoun] is the only senior staffer who still wants everyone to get along.

BackstoryDef.title: Power Distribution Engineer
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] decides how the reactor's output gets split between the divisions. Every shortage turns into an argument, so [PAWN_pronoun] keeps [PAWN_possessive] logs in perfect order before anyone comes asking.

BackstoryDef.title: Advanced Systems Researcher
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: Talented, and fully aware of it. [PAWN_nameDef]'s long feud with Max Loken over credit and lab space once ended with the two of them barricaded in BioScience with weapons drawn.

BackstoryDef.title: Robotics Researcher
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] works on synth motor control down on the Robotics floor. [PAWN_pronoun] is quick to anger and slow to forgive, and every division knows about the grudge [PAWN_pronoun] holds against Lawrence Higgs.

BackstoryDef.title: Senior Advanced Systems Scientist
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: Decades in Advanced Systems have made [PAWN_nameDef] the name the Directorate would reach for if Madison Li ever left. [PAWN_pronoun] is careful and dry, with no taste for politics.

BackstoryDef.title: BioScience Researcher
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: One of the younger faces in BioScience. [PAWN_nameDef] is earnest, a little green, and puts in longer hours than anyone asks of [PAWN_objective].

BackstoryDef.title: BioScience Geneticist
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] runs the gene work behind BioScience's crop and animal programs. Ask about [PAWN_possessive] results and [PAWN_pronoun]'ll talk for an hour. Ask about the test subjects and the conversation is suddenly over.

BackstoryDef.title: Advanced Systems Physicist
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] helped work out the math behind the molecular relay. Exacting and private, [PAWN_pronoun] has a habit of answering questions with better ones.

BackstoryDef.title: Advanced Systems Technician
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: Somebody has to keep Advanced Systems' test rigs calibrated, and for years that somebody has been [PAWN_nameDef]. It's thankless work, and the division would grind to a halt without it.

BackstoryDef.title: Robotics Technician
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] builds and repairs synth components on the Robotics line. [PAWN_pronoun] knows a Gen 2 frame well enough to strip one down in the dark.

BackstoryDef.title: Advanced Systems Assistant
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: A junior hand in Advanced Systems, [PAWN_nameDef] is still trying to prove [PAWN_objective]self to a division that judges people by their published work.

BackstoryDef.title: Restless Son
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up on the Robotics floor watching [PAWN_possessive] father build synths. At some point [PAWN_pronoun] started seeing them as people, and started quietly helping a few of them escape under the name Patriot.

BackstoryDef.title: Corridor Kid
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] has never seen the sky and doesn't much care. The Institute's corridors are the whole world to [PAWN_objective], and [PAWN_pronoun] knows every one of them.

BackstoryDef.title: Classroom Prodigy
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] is already working through lessons meant for kids twice [PAWN_possessive] age. [PAWN_possessive] teachers have started arguing over which division gets [PAWN_objective].

BackstoryDef.title: Diamond City Orphan
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up in Diamond City and lost [PAWN_possessive] parents young. The streets taught [PAWN_objective] that a gun settles most arguments, and nothing since has changed [PAWN_possessive] mind.

BackstoryDef.title: Institute Contractor
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: The Institute keeps [PAWN_nameDef] on retainer for the jobs it won't send its own people to do. They paid for the cybernetics that have kept [PAWN_objective] alive far past a normal lifespan, and [PAWN_pronoun] pays them back in work and silence.

BackstoryDef.title: Prototype Child
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] was built to look like a ten-year-old boy and to stay that way. Father calls the project a test of how well a synth can pass as a child. The boy has started asking why nobody will tell him where his parents went.

BackstoryDef.title: Mayor of Diamond City
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] won the mayor's office with handshakes and a ready smile. Few voters know the real McDonough was replaced years ago, or that the synth in [PAWN_possessive] place takes orders from the Institute.

BackstoryDef.title: Robotics Field Agent
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] spent years hunting one runaway unit across the Capital Wasteland, sure the A3-21 prototype was too valuable to write off. To [PAWN_objective], anyone who helps a synth escape is a thief and nothing more.
